actual: EfficientGATs seed with model_config.class=EfficientGATs routes through real QE dispatch to qlib.contrib.model.pytorch_gats_ts.GATs because _get_model_info does not SELECT or return model_config. The GATs branch then defaults to original qlib GATs and full-pool dispatch OOMs. Fix _get_model_info to include and parse model_config, keep builtin model_info shape consistent, and add an integration test through the real _get_model_info path for EfficientGATs plus original GATs regression.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
